messages:
ashley: FYI — finance flagged duplicated invoice lines for reseller R-1123. Same request shows two charge lines (hosted SKU + fallback dedicated SKU).

sam: can you paste an example event? cc @billing @metering-bot

ashley: here's a sanitized event snippet we pulled from ingest:
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_9a7f",
  "client_id": "R-1123",
  "model_route": "open-gen-3",
  "final_route": "dedicated-gen-3-eu",
  "routing_meta": ["original_route:open-gen-3", "fallback:dedicated-gen-3-eu"],
  "billing_tags": ["sku:gen-text", "sku:dedicated-gen-text"]
}
```

jordan: looks like the routing middleware appends both original & fallback tags to the metering event. billing dedupe uses a fingerprint concat that includes billing_tags => ends up splitting into two lines. for resellers that causes double-billing on invoice view.

metering-bot: Alert: duplicate invoice lines detected for 42 requests in last 24h for reseller:R-1123 (rule: duplicate-sku-fingerprint).

natalie: do we know if this is from shadow/canary routing or actual production fallbacks?

ashley: confirmed production — proxy triggered fallback due to cold KV cache in eu region. requests actually routed to dedicated pool. original route preserved in metadata.

thomas: quick idea: ingest should set a single canonical charge tag (billing_tag) based on final_route, and move previous tags into attribution_tags. billing system should only consume billing_tag for invoice lines. dashboards can show attribution_tags.

liz: strong +1 on separation, but warning: some teams rely on per-route quota accounting using original_route. if we drop it entirely we'll break quota dashboards & rollout metrics. need both fields.

jordan: agreed. schema proposal:
```json
{
  "billing_tag": "sku:dedicated-gen-text",
  "attribution_tags": ["sku:gen-text", "route:open-gen-3"]
}
```

ashley: that works. question: how do we migrate already-ingested events / invoices? finance asked for a reconciliation plan — they want a list of affected invoices and a fix path.

sam: migration plan outline:
- producer change (proxy/routing) to emit billing_tag + attribution_tags (canary to 5% of traffic)
- ingest filter change to normalize and dedupe by billing_tag for billing pipeline
- backfill job to reprocess events for last 90 days where billing_tags.length > 1 and reseller present
- reconciliation script to aggregate delta per invoice and create adjustment lines
- UI flag in console to collapse attribution lines so customers see primary charge first

thomas: rough estimates: producer 2d, ingest 1d, backfill 2d plus ops window. Finance needs to sign off on adjustments.

natalie: also update telemetry: add metric metering.duplicate_charge_count and a tracer span when routing adds multiple charge tags. want to surface in ops dashboard and create an alert.

metering-bot: Ticket created: MTR-834 "Reseller: billing_tag + attribution_tags, dedupe ingest" (linked).

liz: small UX ask for console: when invoice line was auto-adjusted, show original attribution collapsed under a disclosure chevron and include "why" text. Finance prefers explicit footnote.

ashley: can we limit initial rollout to dedicated+reseller combos? minimizes blast radius.

sam: yep. canary gating by customer type + region. cc @eng-sre for deploy window.

jordan: I'll draft a minimal RFC with schema, sample events, and a simple pseudocode ingest dedupe function.

thomas: I'll own the ops playbook and backfill job. will sync with finance tomorrow 10am.

ashley: thanks all — this feels like a clear path. tagging follow-ups: @jordan (RFC), @thomas (backfill + ops), @natalie (telemetry), @liz (console UX).

sam: :thumbsup:

liz: :eyes:

metering-bot: Note: related past incidents: INC-502 (invoice-split-eu-fallback) referenced in ticket.
